## Who is Saqlain Abid?
Saqlain Abid is a Pakistan-based web developer, automation practitioner and founder of Saraiki Tech.
He builds conversion-focused websites and Shopify stores, creates AI content systems, and does YouTube SEO.
He also teaches YouTube, TikTok and Facebook automation through crash courses.
Working worldwide, communication in English. Based in Pakistan.
